messages:
Maya (CS): FYI preparing QBR for Cedarlane Health next Mon. Big uptick in embeddings after a weekly sync. Need spend forecast + renewal risk notes.
Jordan (FinOps): I'll build baseline, commit-tier, and 95pct burst scenarios split by route. ETA today.
Ken (Onboarding): They turned on client batching but not server prefixing. Quick fix could cut duplicate embed calls ~35%. I'll draft config.
Lina (Eval): Can run a 60-query eval against embed-std and embed-std-quant. Metrics: recall@10, avg cosine drop, and human review on 15 samples.
Marco (AM): Customer wants a predictable monthly corridor and will consider a 12mo commit if we guarantee <12% embedding recall delta. Chat must be unchanged.
Maya (CS): Alerts: need soft at 60% of proposed commit (notify CS/AM) and hard at 95% that auto-routes 12% traffic to a lower-cost embed.
alerts-bot: Created alerts: Cedarlane_warn_60 -> #cs-ops + marco@redwood.com; Cedarlane_emergency_95 -> auto-route embeddings->embed-std-quant (12% traffic).
Jordan (FinOps): Sample CSV head:
route,30d_tokens,baseline_monthly,commit_60M,commit_120M,95pct_tail
embeddings,36,34000000,32000000,28000000,61000000
chat,6,7000000,6500000,6200000,13000000
(full CSV in Drive)
Ken (Onboarding): Canary command for staging: ```rdwctl set-route cedarlane embeddings prefix_cache=true cache_ttl=86400 batch_size=256``` will run and post token deltas.
Lina (Eval): Quick headline: quant reduces embedding cost ~26% with median recall loss ~5%. I'll drop full eval doc and sample diffs by EOD.
Marco (AM): I'll pitch commit tiers + a rollback clause: auto-rollback if customer-facing recall drops >10% for two consecutive weeks.
Maya (CS): Action items: Jordan -> full CSV + scenario sheet; Ken -> canary results + config; Lina -> eval doc; Marco -> term outline. I'll assemble slides and post draft in #qbr-deck. :thumbsup:
